$comment: SkyTrain operating assumptions for run inference and movements (PLAN.md §4.3–4.4). All 'guess' unless noted; see docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #1–#8, #18. Times in seconds, distances in metres, speeds in km/h.

fleets.$comment: Lines whose trains are interchangeable, so a run may continue from one line's trip onto another's (interlining). Expo and Millennium share rolling stock and OMC 1 (diagram v3).

turnback.$minLayoverS: Minimum time from arrival at a terminus to departure of the next trip: unloading, reversing, loading (driverless trains change ends quickly). Too high and trains skip to a later departure, overfilling terminus berths. guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #6
turnback.$maxLayoverS: Longer gaps end the run (train goes to a yard) rather than waiting at the terminus.
turnback.$stubMaxLayoverS: At stub termini (Waterfront Expo/Canada, Lafarge Lake–Douglas, …) a train that would wait longer than this for a departure (in place or via the tail tracks) is surplus: it returns to the yard empty instead of occupying the platform. Operators run such trains between scheduled trains (Braden, 2026-09-26; OPEN-QUESTIONS #21). guess
turnback.$reversalS: Time to change ends / reverse direction (driverless, so short). guess
turnback.$blockBonusS: Unused since GTFS block successors are now always preferred (kept for config compatibility).

yard.$comment: Pull-outs/pull-ins between yards and the first/last platform of each run (OPEN-QUESTIONS #1–#3). The nearest reachable yard by track distance is used.
yard.$pullOutLeadS: Pull-outs arrive at the first platform this long before the first departure.
yard.$deadheadSpeedFactor: Deadheads run at this fraction of line max speed: about the line's average including stops, so pull-outs don't catch up with trains in service.
yard.$runIntoYardM: How far into the yard a pulling-in train is drawn before it disappears (and a pull-out appears).
